# Lexical Structure & Literals

## Source encoding, comments, and layout

| Lexical Element | Specification | Diagnostic |
|---|---|---|
| **File suffix & encoding** | UTF-8 text in `.dva` source files | — |
| **Comments** | `//` to end of line; discarded before token stream construction | — |
| **Significant indentation** | Spaces only (no tabs). Indentation deeper than the current block margin opens a block or continues an expression; returning to an outer column closes open blocks | `E1011`: tab in indentation<br>`E1004` / `E2017`: dedent to unaligned column |
| **Inline-started blocks** | Any block or branch body (`|`, `!|`, `[guard]`, `=>`, `!=>`, `@`, `@@`, `>--`) is a block whether its first statement starts on the next line or on the **same line** as the opener (`| first_line` followed by subsequent statements at `+2` spaces; `fn = a, b => first_line` or `[Guard] first_line` followed by subsequent statements at `+3` spaces) | — |
| **Line continuation** | Lines inside `(...)`, `[...]`, `{...}`, or `<...>`, or following a trailing binary/continuation operator (indented `+2` spaces), continue the current expression without emitting statement breaks | — |
| **Multiline column alignment** | Aligned items in multiline `#type` record/enum blocks are separated by newlines; multiple items on a single line require commas | `E2015`: missing comma on same line |
| **Same-line sequence (`;`)** | `a; b` sequences statements on a single line (LBP 20, RBP 30) and yields the last expression's value | — |

## Identifiers, primes, and directives

Edva has **no reserved keywords**. Identifiers, types, and directives are distinguished by lexical form:

| Category | Lexical Form | Rules & Semantics | Diagnostic |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Value / function identifier** | `[a-z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*` | Lowercase or `_`-prefixed ASCII/Unicode name | — |
| **Primed identifier** | `name'`, `name''`, ... | Declares a mutable/rebindable variable or stepped SSA version (`x' = x + 1`). Once primed, reassignments may write `x' = v` or `x = v` | `E3033`: reassigning unprimed `x` |
| **Exact underscore (`_`)** | `_` | Implicit lambda parameter `(_ * 2)`, operator section parameter `(* 2)`, partial-application slot `f(_, 5)` / `x $> f(a, _)`, implicit cycle item, bare ram/variant payload, or pattern wildcard `(a, _)` | `E2040`: explicit `_ =>`<br>`E2044`: `_ = expr`<br>`E3004`: unbound `_` |
| **Cycle index (`_i`)** | `_i` | Implicit `0`-based index in count/range/string/array cycles, or key in map cycles (`m @` block); scoped strictly to the cycle body | `E3004`: reading `_i` after cycle exit |
| **Nominal type / variant** | `[A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*` | Built-in types (`Int`, `Float`, `Rune`, `String`, `Builder`, `Addr`, `Error`, `Type`), `#type` names, and enum variant labels | `E2012`: lowercase enum variant |
| **Custom operator name** | `(op_chars)` | Symbolic operator function declared/referenced in parentheses, e.g. `(+++): Int, Int => Int` | — |
| **Compiler directive** | `#name` / `#!` | `#type`, `#use`, `#public` (`#pub`), `#private` (`#priv`), `#foreign`, `#export`, `#packed`, `#align`, `#size`, `#!` | `E1015`: unknown directive |
| **Compiler intrinsic** | `%name(...)` | Direct LLVM-lowered operation (`%min`, `%sqrt`, `%popcount`, `%memcpy`, `%to_str`, etc.); must be called with `(...)` | `E3100`: bare `%name` without call |

```{.dva .run}
#use io

total = 10
total' = total + 5
total'' = total' * 2
io::out $ total''
```

## Literals

### Numeric, rune, and builder literals

| Literal Kind | Syntax Examples | Type | Lexical & Semantic Rules | Diagnostic |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Decimal integer** | `0`, `42`, `-7`, `10{6}` | `Int` (`i64`) | Signed 64-bit integer. `{N}` repeats preceding digit `N` times (`10{6}` $\equiv$ `1000000`). Underscore separators (`1_000`) are forbidden | `E1019`: `_` in numeric literal |
| **Radix integer** | `0xDEAD`, `0b1011`, `0o755`, `0b1{48}` | `Int` (`i64`) | Hexadecimal (`0x`), binary (`0b`), octal (`0o`), with optional `{N}` bit/digit repetition | `E1004` / `E1005`: invalid radix digit |
| **Sized integer** | `127i8`, `8080u16`, `1u32`, `9i64`, `9u64` | `i8`..`i64`, `u8`..`u64` | Explicit fixed-width signed or unsigned integer literal | — |
| **Floating-point** | `3.14`, `1.0e-9`, `-2.5`, `1.25f32` | `Float` (`f64`) or `f32` | Requires decimal point or exponent (`e`/`E`); `f32` suffix yields 32-bit float | `E1019`: `_` in float literal |
| **Rune** | `'a`, `'λ`, `'🦀`, `'\n`, `'\s`, `''`, `'\x1b`, `'\u{1F600}` | `Rune` (`i32`) | Leading-apostrophe Unicode scalar value (`U+0000`..`U+10FFFF`, no closing `'`). Supports `\n`, `\r`, `\t`, `\s` (space `32`), `\0`, `\e`, `\\`, `''` / `\'` (apostrophe `39`), `\xHH`, `\u{HEX}` | `E1009`: bare `'` followed by whitespace/Unicode `Zs`/EOF<br>`E1010`: closing `'` (`'a'`) |
| **Builder capacity** | `{16}`, `{1024}` | `Builder` | Allocates a mutable arena byte buffer with initial capacity `N` bytes | — |

### String literals (`"..."`)

Edva unifies single-line and multi-line strings under double quotes `"..."`:

| Feature | Syntax | Behavior | Diagnostic |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Single-line string** | `"hello\nworld"` | Immutable `{ len, data }` UTF-8 string with NUL-reserved tail (`data[len] == 0`) | `E1003`: unclosed string |
| **Escape sequences** | `\n` `\t` `\r` `\0` `\a` `\b` `\f` `\v` `\e` `\"` `\'` `\\` `\$` `\xHH` `\u{HEX}` | Standard C/Unicode escapes; `\$` escapes `${...}` interpolation | `E1006`: invalid escape |
| **Expression interpolation** | `"count = ${n + 1}"` | Evaluates scalar/string `expr` via `%to_str(expr)` (or streams directly into `b += "..."` without intermediate allocation) | `E3105`: non-scalar in `${...}` |
| **Multi-line string** | `"` followed immediately by `\n` | Strips opening newline and strips the first content line's leading whitespace (**baseline margin**) from all subsequent lines | `E1017`: line indented less than baseline margin |
| **Multi-line closing quote** | Closing `"` on its own line vs end of content line | Own line preserves final `\n`; end of content line omits final `\n`; trailing `\` before `\n` joins lines without `\n` | — |

```{.dva .run}
#use io

mask = 0b1{8}
name = "Edva"
msg = "
   Language: ${name}
   Mask:     ${mask}
   "
io::out $ msg
```

### Ramification and container literals

| Construct | Syntax | Type | Semantics |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Flag literals** | `<+>`, `<->` | `<>` (`RamNN`) | Unboxed `i1` boolean true (`1`) and false (`0`) |
| **Unit ram literals** | `<++>`, `<-->` | `< | E >` / `< T | >` | Positive success unit (`<++>`) and negative absence unit (`<-->`); never implicitly coerced from `<+>` / `<->` |
| **Single-payload ram** | `<+ val +>`, `<- err ->` | `< T | >`, `< | E >` | Positive payload of `RamPN` (`<+ val +>`) or negative payload of `RamNP` (`<- err ->`) |
| **Two-payload ram** | `<+ val ->`, `<- err +>` | `< T | E >` (`RamPP`) | Positive (`<+ val ->`) or negative (`<- err +>`) payload of a two-payload result |
| **Record / tuple literal** | `(10, 20)`, `(x = 1, y = 2)` | Positional or named record | Single-element tuple is not distinct from grouping; homogeneous repetition `val {N}` produces `(T * N)` |
| **Map literal** | `("a" ^= 1, "b" ^= 2)` | `K ^ V` | Constructs and populates an arena hash map from `key ^= value` pairs (`K` in `String`, `Int`, `Addr`) |
